title_sq: Tek Rruga E Elbasanit, Shitet Super Apartamnet 2+1+2 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme!!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Xheluks, ne Rrugen e Elbasanit, prane Ambasades Austriake shitet super apartament 2+1+2 me hapesira te bollshme. Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 134.1 m2 ,neto 115.6 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati 6-katesh. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit , nje dhome gjumi me tualet te dedikuar dhe garderobe, dhe 1 dhome tjeter gjumi dhe nje tualet kryesor. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Perendim cka ben te kete diell dhe drite pjesen me te madhe te dites. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj. Apartamenti eshte ne faza perfundimtare dhe behet shume shpejt gati per banim. Bashke me apartamentin shitet dhe nje post parkimi i ndodhur ne katin -1 te godines i aksesueshem nga ashensori me vlere ekstra 20.000 euro.
title_en: At Rruga E Elbasani, Super Apartments 2+1+2 With Ample Spaces For Sale!!!
description_en: At the Xeluks Complex, on Elbasan Street, near the Austrian Embassy, ​​a super apartment 2+1+2 with ample space is for sale. The apartment with a gross area of ​​134.1 m2, net 115.6 m2 is located on the 3rd floor of a 6-story building. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner, a bedroom with dedicated toilet and wardrobe, and 1 other bedroom and a main toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-West, which makes it sunny and bright most of the day. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The apartment is in the final stages and will be ready for occupancy very soon. Along with the apartment, a parking post located on the -1st floor of the building, accessible from the elevator, is sold with an extra value of 20,000 euros.
